William will be at Union Square from 10:45AM to 5:30PM. You'd like to meet William for a minimum of 45 minutes. Elizabeth will be at Nob Hill from 12:15PM to 3:00PM. You'd like to meet Elizabeth for a minimum of 105 minutes. Joseph will be at Fisherman's Wharf from 12:45PM to 2:00PM. You'd like to meet Joseph for a minimum of 75 minutes. Anthony will be at Golden Gate Park from 1:00PM to 8:30PM. You'd like to meet Anthony for a minimum of 75 minutes. Barbara will be at Embarcadero from 7:15PM to 8:30PM. You'd like to meet Barbara for a minimum of 75 minutes. Carol will be at Financial District from 11:45AM to 4:15PM. You'd like to meet Carol for a minimum of 60 minutes. Sandra will be at North Beach from 10:00AM to 12:30PM. You'd like to meet Sandra for a minimum of 15 minutes. Kenneth will be at Presidio from 9:15PM to 10:15PM. You'd like to meet Kenneth for a minimum of 45 minutes.

Explanation of the schedule:

• You arrive at Marina at 09:00. Instead of trying an early‐morning meeting (note: Kenneth isn’t available until 21:15), you first head to North Beach. (Travel: Marina → North Beach is 11 minutes.)  
 – At North Beach, you meet Sandra from exactly 10:00 to 10:15 (her minimum 15‐minute meeting fits in her 10:00–12:30 window).

• Next you quickly travel from North Beach to Union Square (7 minutes) so that by 10:45 you can start your 45‐minute meeting with William (available 10:45–17:30).

• When William’s meeting ends at 11:30, you travel 9 minutes from Union Square to the Financial District to meet Carol. You arrive by 11:39, wait a few minutes and meet Carol from 11:45 to 12:45 (meeting her 60‐minute minimum within her 11:45–16:15 window).

• Leaving Carol at 12:45, you take an 8‑minute trip from the Financial District to Nob Hill. Arriving at 12:53—well inside Elizabeth’s 12:15–15:00 window—you meet her for 105 minutes (until 14:38).

• Then you move on from Nob Hill to Golden Gate Park (17‑minute trip) and start your 75‑minute meeting with Anthony from 14:55 to 16:10 (Anthony is available 13:00–20:30).

• Next, you travel 7 minutes from Golden Gate Park to Richmond District and begin your 75‑minute meeting with Stephanie at 16:17. By 17:32 you’ve completed her meeting within her 16:15–21:30 window.

• With the afternoon meetings done, you later travel from Richmond District to Embarcadero (19 minutes) and, after waiting until 19:15, meet Barbara for 75 minutes (her window is exactly 19:15–20:30).

• Finally, from Embarcadero you travel 20 minutes to Presidio. Arriving by 20:50 you wait until Kenneth’s availability begins at 21:15 and then meet him for 45 minutes (until 22:00) inside his 21:15–22:15 window.

This schedule lets you meet 8 friends (Sandra, William, Carol, Elizabeth, Anthony, Stephanie, Barbara and finally Kenneth) while satisfying each person’s location‐ and time‐window constraints and the minimum meeting durations. (Because Elizabeth’s 105‑minute block and Joseph’s 75‑minute block overlap too tightly, you must choose one – here the schedule “optimizes” by including Elizabeth.)
